comments.author: @machipera8181
comments.text: Fun fact about Sequoyah, he was actually illiterate before teaching himself how to read. Also he kinda speedran writing, he first created a pictographic script, then a logographic one and finally he arrived at a phonetic one. This is really impressive if you consider the fact that this took hundreds of generations for other scripts but Sequoyah just did it in a span of relatively short time. The writing itself was inspired by European scripts (Latin, Glagolitic, Greek etc.) but Sequoyah couldn't read any of that so that's why the symbols look like the ones in European scripts but don't represent the same sounds.
